review_response_tasks.stem: When the visitor thanked her, Sara smiled ____. (polite)
review_response_tasks.rationale: politely：副词修饰smiled，表示有礼貌地微笑。；polite：形容词不能在这里直接修饰smiled。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Our class has already ____ how to make a paper fan. (learn)
review_response_tasks.rationale: learned：has后用过去分词，learned合法。；learnt：learnt也是已核过去分词，和learned同等接受。；learn：has后缺过去分词。；learning：has后不能直接接learning构成此完成时。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: The first story held my attention much longer than the second. I found it ____ than the second one. (interesting)
review_response_tasks.rationale: more interesting：前句明确第一篇更吸引注意，比较级more interesting符合语义和than结构。；interesting：此处有than比较，原级不合。；most interesting：最高级不合两项than比较。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Tom swims for the school team. He is an excellent ____. (swim)
review_response_tasks.rationale: swimmer：an excellent后需单数可数的人物名词swimmer。；swim：原形动词不是此处表示运动员的名词。；swimmers：an后不接复数。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: The children were ____ towards the finish line when I took the photo. (run)
review_response_tasks.rationale: running：were后用running构成过去进行时，双写n。；run：were后原形不成此主动进行时。；runned：run无runned词形。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。
